in_sanskrit.name: राजराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rājarāja, a compound name composed of rāja meaning 'king' and rāja meaning 'king'. The name signifies a king of kings, an emperor, a monarch of great power and might.

in_hindi.name: राजराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rājā kē Rājā, the king of kings in Hindi.

in_telugu.name: రాజరాజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rājarāja, a Telugu name that translates to 'emperor of emperors' or 'king of kings'.
